== Name
verbatim-links - enabled code links retain destinations

== Synopsis
*verbatim-links*

== Description

[source,text,subs=+macros]
----
C01 https://example.org[Label].
  C02 link:https://example.org[Indented]  tail.
C03 (https://example.org[Joined])suffix.
C04 https://example.org[].
C05 https://example.org and test@example.org.
C06 mailto:test@example.org[Mail,Subject,Body]!
C07 mailto:test@example.org[].
C08 xref:target[Local] and xref:other.adoc#target[External].
C09 <<target>> and xref:missing[Missing].
C10 https://example.org[A "quote" and \path]\tail.
C11 https://example.org[Label]
.SH literal-control-line
'literal-control-line
C12 https://example.org[Label]pass:[.]
C13 pass:m[link:https://example.org[Pass link\]] pass:[link:https://literal.example[Literal]].
C14 https://example.org[{blank}] café.
----

[source,text,subs="+quotes,+macros"]
----
C15 *Before  https://example.org[Bold]  after*.
C16 _Before mailto:test@example.org[Italic] after_.
C17 `Before link:https://example.org[Mono] after`.
----

[subs=+macros]
....
  C18 https://example.org[Literal]  after.
	C19 mailto:test@example.org[Tabbed]suffix.
....

[source,text,subs=+macros]
C20 https://example.org[Source paragraph].

[listing,subs=+macros]
C21 link:https://example.org[Listing paragraph].

[literal,subs=+macros]
C22 mailto:test@example.org[Literal paragraph].

[source,text,subs=-macros]
----
C23 https://example.org[Disabled] mailto:test@example.org[Disabled].
----

[source,text,subs="attributes,quotes,macros"]
----
C24 https://example.org[{name}] *{name}*.
----

[source,rust,subs=+macros]
----
C25 https://example.org[Callout] // <1>
----
<1> Callout body.

[source,text,subs=+macros]
----
C26 https://example.org[(C)] (C).
----

[source,text,subs="+macros,+replacements"]
----
C27 https://example.org[(C)].
----

[literal,subs="+macros,+replacements"]
C28 https://example.org[(C)].

[source,xml,subs=+macros]
----
C29 <value>https://example.org[XML]</value> <!--1-->
----
<1> XML callout body.

[[target]]
== Target
Target body.
